description.value:
Duration constant

Undertow-flavored, open to all — a fully dragged-down target can no longer act at all until it breaks free.

A creature slowed 2 by THE SLOW PULL can take no actions except to attempt to break free, which requires a successful Athletics or Acrobatics check against your class DC as a single action; each failed attempt gives it a cumulative +2 circumstance bonus to its next attempt. Success ends THE SLOW PULL. It is not helpless.

cinderfall.incomplete: A slowed creature can attempt an Athletics/Acrobatics check against your class DC to break free, with a cumulative +2 circumstance bonus on each failed attempt -- no rule element auto-increments a custom counter round over round outside a named condition's own badge-increment or a SpecialResource, neither of which exists for this shape (NOSTACK); the DC-vs-class-DC check itself needs no automation and isn't a gap.
